Dropping an old ESET AV Remover installer and a Dharma binary (taskhost.exe) to encrypt victim's hard drives
Appending the ETH extension to encrypted file names
Using Enigma1crypt@aol.com email address to contact ransomware developer
Attack Vector: Spam email campaign with password-protected self-extracting archive attachment
Indicators of Compromise: Dropped files: Defender_nt32_enu.exe (ESET AV Remover installer), taskhost.exe (Dharma binary)
Malicious attachment hosted on hacked server link.fivetier.com
